relationships.subject: Piezo2
relationships.evidence_quote: A Piezo2 deficiency correlated with reduced RVD and prolonged cell swelling, leading to heightened release of the neurotrophic factor BDNF

relationships.subject: Piezo2
relationships.evidence_quote: Piezo2 may contribute to RVD, thereby maintaining cellular homeostasis, and may also serve as a negative regulator of neurotrophic factor release

key_findings: Piezo2 in differentiated Schwann cells contributes to regulatory volume decrease; Piezo2 deficiency increases BDNF release via TRPV4.
